description: Lists or searches every page on vertodigital.com. Without query, returns the site index as markdown: one link and a one-line summary per page, grouped under section headings such as Services, Industries, Case studies, Content Hub and Agent API (fetched live from /llms.txt, under 30 KB). With query, searches the title and summary of every page, including each blog post, event, ebook, video and case study from the full Content Hub and case-study indexes, and returns only the matching links grouped by section. Each link has the form https://vertodigital.com/markdown/<slug>.md, and <slug> is the input vertodigital_get_page expects. Use it to find pages on a topic; to search inside case-study text for stats and outcomes, use vertodigital_search_case_studies, and to match a buyer's challenge to a service, use vertodigital_get_value_proposition. A page matches query when every word starts a word in its title or summary (case-insensitive, so "attribut" finds "attribution"); no match returns match_count: 0 with a hint, not an error. section narrows either mode to headings containing it; a section that matches nothing is ignored and section_found comes back false.

query.description: Keywords to search page titles and summaries site-wide, e.g. "LinkedIn Ads", "AI search", "attribution", "Cribl". Omit to list the index instead.

section.description: Section heading to filter to, e.g. "Services", "Case studies", "Content Hub", "Blog", "Industries". Case-insensitive substring match against section headings. Omit for all sections.

name: vertodigital_get_site_index

markdown.description: The document as markdown - identical to the text content block.

match_count.description: Number of matching pages when query was given, otherwise null

query.description: The search query that was applied, or null when the index was listed

section.description: The section filter that was requested, or null for all sections

section_found.description: True when the requested section matched a heading (or no section was requested); false when it matched nothing and was ignored
